title: Native run: big window, big md0, no transfer - does the payload kernel boot with a 4908 MiB window, advertise 16 KiB pages, accept a 2.3 GiB md0 and still run the project probe as PID 1, and does the loader-side watchdog pet reload the counter (cap 150 s for this run, reset to Download Mode at the cap)
acceptance: One run of the NAT-074 image under its own decision file (committed first, per-image, RECOVERY only, restored from the pinned stock by NAT-013); host receives the loader and kernel text unattended.

Observed and reported separately: loader window base/size; the kernel's page count and page size in vm_page_bootstrap; the md0 line with the 16 KiB-aligned size; the probe's two lines and exit 81; the pet counter and whether the phone was still running past 83.9 s of the loader clock; boot time; Android check after restore. A SEC_UPLOAD ending (pet did not reload) is a recorded finding that needs the owner's keys, not a pass.
evidence.json (native-device) with outcome from the decision's pass rule; task done before the native permit is closed.
